values.note: Hickory Ridge Campground: 38 electric/water sites up to 40 ft and 28 no-hookup sites up to 30 ft, plus 4 yurts, a bunkhouse and a tent group site. The separate Chestnut Hollow equestrian campground (24 horse sites) is for campers with horses and books by phone only.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/grayson-highlands (Total sites of each type; Site types), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Hickory Ridge sites are reserved by site number, online or at 1-800-933-PARK; 'reservations are strongly recommended'. Chestnut Hollow (equestrian) books by phone only, open to non-equestrians from 30 days before arrival.

summary: Added 50-amp electric + water (38 E/W sites to 40 ft, 28 no-hookup to 30 ft), 66 sites, showers, dump, camp store, no laundry, reservable by site. Season NOT changed (manual, from DCR's statewide camping page) though the park page narrows it: see flag. Not stated: sewer, booking window/cutoff, fcfs, max stay; fees already from DCR's table.
flags: season conflict with a manual value: the entry says 03-01 to 12-07 (DCR statewide camping page, read 2026-10-20), but the park's own page says 'full-service camping is only available from May through October' and 'Primitive camping is allowed in Chestnut Hollow campground [the equestrian one] during March, April and November ... No camping is available from the first Monday in December until the first Friday in March.' So the RV campground (Hickory Ridge) appears to run May-October only; a human should decide whether to narrow the season to 05-01/10-31 with a note about primitive camping in Chestnut Hollow in March, April and November.
